gloss: no drinking allowed; prohibition of alcohol

definitions.gloss: no drinking allowed; prohibition of alcohol
definitions.explanation: A rule, regulation, or instruction prohibiting the consumption of alcoholic beverages. Commonly seen on signs, in workplace rules, and in medical instructions.

examples.japanese: ここは{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}です。
{公園|こうえん}に「{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}」の{看板|かんばん}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: There's a 'No Drinking' sign posted in the park.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}の{前日|ぜんじつ}は{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}と{医者|いしゃ}に{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The doctor told me no alcohol the day before the surgery.

notes:
A compound of {飲酒|いんしゅ} (drinking alcohol) and {禁止|きんし} (prohibition). This is a four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}-style) commonly seen on signs and in written rules. In daily speech, people might simply say お{酒|さけ}はだめ or お{酒|さけ}は{禁止|きんし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}の{看板|かんばん} — no-drinking sign
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}エリア — no-alcohol area
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}の{規則|きそく} — no-drinking rule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {禁酒|きんしゅ} — abstinence from alcohol (personal choice or medical instruction, not a sign/rule)
- {飲酒運転禁止|いんしゅうんてんきんし} — no drunk driving (more specific)
- {喫煙禁止|きつえんきんし} — no smoking (same pattern with different activity)
